title: Earth Signs: Traits, Best Matches & Dates
description: Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn—practical traits, strengths, growth edges, dates, rulers and best matches. House echoes + links to each sign. Make your chart free.
subtitle: Earth signs build what lasts. Practical, steady, and craft-obsessed, they turn ideas into structure. If your chart stacks Earth, you move through life via skills, proof, and results . Start with your birth chart to see where Earth concentrates.

sections.heading: What “Earth Signs” Means
sections.html:
• Core vibe: grounded, reliable, hands-on; values process and proof.
  • Strengths: patience, craftsmanship, resource management, loyalty.
  • Growth edges: flexibility, warmth under stress, releasing perfectionism.
  • House echoes: Earth resonates with 2nd, 6th, and 10th—money, work, mastery.

sections.heading: Earth Rulers to Study
sections.html:
• Venus — value, taste, comfort; invest in beauty that works.
  • Mercury — process, checklists, iteration; feedback is fuel.
  • Saturn — time, boundaries, mastery; slow is smooth, smooth is fast.

sections.heading: Earth Signs in Love & Compatibility
sections.html:
• Best elemental flow: Earth + Water — stability meets care. See Earth & Water.
  • Easy resonance: Earth + Earth — shared pace and priorities; avoid ruts. See Earth & Earth.
  • Friction with learning: Earth + Fire/Air — speed vs. proof; agree on budgets and timelines. Try Fire & Earth and Earth & Air.
  • Next step: check specific pairs in the compatibility library.

sections.heading: Earth in Your Chart (Beyond Sun Signs)
sections.html:
• Moon/Rising in Earth crave reliability—anchor routines before goals.
  • Earth stellium (3+ placements) = high standards; ship v1, refine in sprints.
  • Check synastry: your Earth placements in their 2nd/6th/10th houses = path to building together; compare in Astrology Charts.

sections.heading: Practical Tips for Earth Signs
sections.html:
• Define “done”: checklist + deadline beats endless polishing.
  • Budget energy like money—protect deep-work blocks.
  • Lead with warmth when stressed; facts land better that way.
  • Celebrate shipped work to avoid “always behind” thinking.
